candidate_note: APT-only update (tools/release/versions/5.0.1.toml: delivery = "apt-only", base_release = "5.0.0"). No 5.0.1 image is built: iso_path, iso_sha256, iso_size_bytes and signature_path name the BASE image, 5.0.0's ISO 2d8a72e0 (4085778432 bytes), copied exactly from qa/5.0.0/acceptance.json; UPGRADE-01 starts from an install of it. apt_packages_sha256 and apt_sources_sha256 are the digests of repo/dists/umbra/main/binary-amd64/Packages and main/source/Sources from the umask-022 rebuild that carries the shadowfetch-fireproof self-upgrade fix (Valid-Until 2027-03-30); they pin every .deb and source file, and acceptance.py record stamps them onto each entry. A rebuilt repository changes both, and every case recorded against these has to be recorded again. Required for publication: SRC-01, PKG-01, UPGRADE-01, DURABLE-01, MISSION-01; the image cases may stay pending. Every case is pending. The case list is carried over from 5.0.0 and every RESULT, waiver and note was dropped rather than copied -- including the six 5.0.0 waivers (MISSION-01, GROK-01, GROK-VISUAL-01, UPGRADE-01, SHADOWCODE-01, STRESS-01), which justified shipping ISO 2d8a72e0 and must be re-argued for 5.0.1 if they are needed at all. ShadowCode stays at the 1.0.0 pin until its owner publishes the signed 1.0.1 release.
